test_title: PYST 18: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 24 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: The profit earned on selling an article for Rs. 4550 is 5 times of the loss incurred on selling the same article for Rs. 3290. What will be the selling price of the article to earn a profit of 20 percent?
solution:
**Given:**

Selling price for profit = Rs. 4550

Selling price for loss = Rs. 3290

Profit earned is 5 times the loss

**Formula Used:**

Profit = Selling Price - Cost Price

Loss = Cost Price - Selling Price

Profit = 5 × Loss

Selling Price for 20% profit = Cost Price × (1 + Profit Percentage)

**Calculation:**

Let Cost Price be CP.

Profit when selling at Rs. 4550:

Profit = 4550 - CP

Loss when selling at Rs. 3290:

Loss = CP - 3290

Given, Profit = 5 × Loss

⇒ 4550 - CP = 5 × (CP - 3290)

⇒ 4550 - CP = 5CP - 16450

⇒ 4550 + 16450 = 6CP

⇒ 21000 = 6CP

⇒ CP = 21000 / 6

⇒ CP = 3500

Selling Price for 20% profit:

SP = CP × (1 + 20/100)

SP = 3500 × 1.2

SP = 4200

**The selling price of the article to earn a profit of 20 percent is Rs. 4200.**
